result.edit: The public test fails when checking divider config=3 (div_e=6, div_o=7) where the output is 1 when expected to be 0 at count=0 cycle=4 mode=0. The issue is in the odd-period output condition where the division by 2 (>>1) was incorrectly changed to division by 4 (>>2). This makes the output stay high for fewer cycles than specified. Changing back to >>1 matches the public waveform contract which requires output to be 1 when count <= floor(div_o/4) + 1 (which is equivalent to count <= (div_o>>1)+1 for these parameters).
